padded.heading: Padded paper (padding set to 2)
padded.text: The paper component has a padding parameter that can be set to one of the spacing values. In this example the padding is set to 2.

padded2.heading: Padded paper (padding set to 4)
padded2.text: The paper component has a padding parameter that can be set to one of the spacing values. In this example the padding is set to 4.
